title: RIPPLE: Recovery Internalization through Process-Level Policy Learning and Effect-Aware Credit for Long-Horizon Agentic Coding
title_zh: RIPPLE：通过过程级策略学习与效果感知信用实现恢复内化的长程智能体编程

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon coding agents can observe a failure and generate a plausible critique yet continue along the same incorrect trajectory. We call this the Critique-to-Action Handoff Gap. We introduce RIPPLE , a recovery-oriented training framework that internalizes process-level guidance into a single self-recovering policy. A prefix-only teacher provides evidence-grounded recovery supervision without access to future actions or terminal outcomes. After lightweight distillation, reinforcement learning assigns stage-specific credit to reflection triggering, diagnosis, and corrective action. Local validity signals gate trajectory advantages so that intermediate recovery decisions do not indiscriminately inherit terminal outcomes. Across four repository-level software-engineering benchmarks, RIPPLE improves the base policy by an arithmetic mean of 4.8 score points, with no auxiliary critic at deployment. Controlled ablations isolate the benefits of local, stage-aligned credit, and matched-prefix interventions show that critique semantics affect subsequent correction. Recovery gains concentrate where the prefix contains sufficient diagnostic evidence and the repository state remains reversible within the remaining budget.

paragraphs.en: Large language model-based coding agents now explore repositories, edit files, execute tests, and revise their behavior using environmental feedback. Repository-level benchmarks and agent frameworks enable these capabilities over long trajectories in realistic software environments ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Pan et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2025 ; Golubev et al., 2025 ; Ding and Zhang, 2026 ) . However, observing feedback does not necessarily imply using it effectively. When a test invalidates an earlier assumption, an agent may continue editing in the same incorrect direction, repeatedly inspect irrelevant files, or fail to revise its plan ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . Although modern agents can close the action–observation loop, reliable recovery from trajectory deviations remains challenging.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大语言模型的编码智能体现在能够探索代码仓库、编辑文件、执行测试，并利用环境反馈调整自身行为。 仓库级基准测试与智能体框架使这些能力能够在真实软件环境中进行长轨迹运行（Jimenez 等, 2024；Yang 等, 2024；Pan 等, 2024；Wei 等, 2025；Golubev 等, 2025；Ding and Zhang, 2026）。 然而，观察到反馈并不一定意味着能有效地利用它。 当测试推翻了先前的假设时，智能体可能继续沿同一错误方向编辑、反复查看无关文件，或未能修订其计划（Zhao 等, 2026；Li 等, 2026a）。 尽管现代智能体能够闭合行动—观察回路，但从轨迹偏差中可靠地恢复仍然充满挑战。

paragraphs.en: Reflection and critique provide a natural mechanism for addressing these failures. Self-generated feedback, verbal memory, tool-assisted critique, and execution-based debugging can improve model outputs ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Gou et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . Recent approaches further train self-correction through supervised learning and reinforcement learning (RL) ( Kumar et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . However, improved task performance does not establish that a critique guides the next action ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . As Figure 1 illustrates, an agent may correctly identify a failure yet take a follow-up action inconsistent with its diagnosis. We refer to this discrepancy as the Critique-to-Action Handoff Gap : an evidence-grounded critique remains behaviorally inert instead of inducing an effective corrective change.
paragraphs.zh: 反思与批评为解决这些失败提供了一种自然机制。 自生成的反馈、言语记忆、借助工具的批评以及基于执行的调试都可以改进模型输出（Madaan et al., 2023；Shinn et al., 2023；Gou et al., 2024；Chen et al., 2023）。 近来的方法进一步通过监督学习和强化学习（RL）来训练自我纠错能力（Kumar et al., 2024；Yuan et al., 2025；Jin et al., 2025；Jiang et al., 2026；Lin et al., 2026）。 然而，任务表现的提升并不能证明批评会引导下一步行动（Shinn et al., 2023；Zhao et al., 2026）。 如图1所示，一个智能体可能正确识别出失败，却采取与其诊断不一致的后续行动。 我们将这种差异称为「批评到行动的交接鸿沟」（Critique-to-Action Handoff Gap）：一个有证据支撑的批评在行为上并未发挥作用，未能引发有效的纠正性改变。

paragraphs.en: This gap exposes a mismatch between the functional structure of recovery and existing training objectives. Critique imitation supervises what the model says about a failure, without establishing whether subsequent actions implement its diagnosis. Terminal rewards supervise trajectory success, but cannot isolate whether reflection was triggered appropriately, the diagnosis was correct, or the corrective action was effective. Process supervision and credit-assignment methods provide finer-grained signals ( Lightman et al., 2023 ; Ekbote et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) , but generally assess intermediate reasoning or redistribute trajectory outcomes rather than separately optimize the functional stages of recovery. Addressing the handoff gap requires jointly learning when to initiate recovery, which diagnosis the evidence supports, and how it should alter subsequent behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 这一差距暴露了恢复的功能结构与现有训练目标之间的不匹配。 批判模仿只监督模型对失败所说的内容，却未能确定后续动作是否落实了其诊断。 终端奖励只监督轨迹是否成功，但无法区分反思是否在恰当的时机被触发、诊断是否正确、或纠正动作是否有效。 过程监督与信用分配方法提供了更细粒度的信号（Lightman et al., 2023；Ekbote et al., 2025；Guo et al., 2026），但通常只是评估中间推理或重新分配轨迹结果，而非分别优化恢复的各个功能阶段。 要解决交接差距，需要联合学习何时启动恢复、证据支持哪种诊断、以及该诊断应如何改变后续行为。

paragraphs.en: We propose RIPPLE , a recovery-oriented training framework for long-horizon coding agents. A trajectory-prefix-conditioned teacher supplies recovery boundaries and reference critiques using only information available at each decision point. Lightweight distillation initializes task execution and interleaved reflection. Recovery-oriented RL then decomposes recovery into reflection triggering, evidence-grounded diagnosis, and corrective action, assigning a distinct process signal to each stage. An executable verifier supervises task correctness, while local validity gates determine whether each recovery span inherits positive or negative trajectory advantage. This design targets the functional contribution of intermediate decisions rather than their co-occurrence with successful trajectories. All auxiliary supervision is confined to training, leaving a single self-recovering policy at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 RIPPLE，一个面向恢复的长时程编码智能体训练框架。 一个以轨迹前缀为条件的教师仅利用每个决策点上可获得的信息，提供恢复边界与参考批评。 轻量级蒸馏用于初始化任务执行与交错反思。 随后，面向恢复的强化学习将恢复分解为反思触发、基于证据的诊断和纠正行动，并为每个阶段分配独立的过程信号。 一个可执行的验证器监督任务正确性，而局部有效性门控决定每个恢复片段继承正向还是负向的轨迹优势。 这一设计关注中间决策的功能性贡献，而非其与成功轨迹的共现。 所有辅助监督仅限于训练阶段，推理时只保留单一的自恢复策略。

paragraphs.en: Repository-level benchmarks establish real-world issue resolution and executable implementation tasks as important settings for evaluating language-model agents ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) . Agent capabilities improve through specialized interaction interfaces, executable training environments, and reinforcement learning over repository-level trajectories ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Pan et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2025 ) . Reusing intermediate agent trajectories improves inference efficiency by preserving progress across attempts ( Ding and Zhang, 2026 ) , while trajectory analyses assess reasoning–action mismatches and localize failure onset in long-horizon executions ( Bouzenia and Pradel, 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . RIPPLE learns an internal recovery policy that responds when new evidence invalidates the agent’s current hypothesis and links diagnosis to subsequent corrective behavior.

paragraphs.en: Process supervision provides intermediate learning signals beyond terminal task outcomes ( Lightman et al., 2023 ) , including generative reward modeling ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) , step-level trajectory calibration, and behavioral critics learned from sparse outcomes ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Each signal applies to the corresponding recovery span, connecting local credit to its behavioral role and reducing terminal reward broadcasting and cross-stage credit mismatch.

paragraphs.en: Recovery also depends on the available evidence and repository state. Among 248 prefixes with sufficient diagnostic evidence and a state judged reversible within the remaining budget, RIPPLE improves execution-verified resolution by 20.4 points over the base policy. Gains are 5.8 points when evidence is sufficient but the state is not reversible, 4.7 when evidence is insufficient but the state is reversible, and 1.7 when neither holds. Test, runtime, compiler, and implicit cross-file evidence show similar gains within the sufficient-and-reversible subset (Appendix F.3 ). These results delineate the recoverability boundary: an effective handoff requires both a diagnosis supported by the observed prefix and a repository state that can still be repaired. The evidence-family decomposition further indicates that recovery is not restricted to explicit test failures; implicit cross-file inconsistencies can also support correction when both conditions hold.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复还取决于可用的证据和仓库状态。 在248个具有充分诊断证据且状态被判定在剩余预算内可逆的前缀中，RIPPLE相比基础策略将经验证的执行解决率提升了20.4个点。 当证据充分但状态不可逆时，提升为5.8个点；当证据不充分但状态可逆时，提升为4.7个点；当两者都不满足时，提升为1.7个点。 在充分且可逆的子集内，测试、运行时、编译器以及隐式跨文件证据显示出相似的提升（附录F.3）。 这些结果划定了可恢复性边界：有效的交接既需要由观测到的前缀支持的诊断，也需要一个仍然可以修复的仓库状态。 证据类别的进一步分解表明，恢复并不局限于显式的测试失败；当两个条件都满足时，隐式的跨文件不一致也可以支持修正。

paragraphs.en: We identify the Critique-to-Action Handoff Gap in long-horizon coding agents and propose RIPPLE to internalize prefix-only recovery guidance. Stage-specific credit distinguishes reflection triggering, diagnosis, and corrective action while retaining terminal task supervision. Local validity gates prevent ineffective recovery decisions from inheriting positive trajectory credit, while protecting useful corrections from negative credit attributable to unrelated failures. Across four software-engineering benchmarks, RIPPLE improves the base policy by an arithmetic mean of 4.8 score points without an online critic. Credit-assignment controls and matched-prefix interventions support the functional contribution of learned critiques. Gains concentrate where diagnostic evidence is sufficient and repository states remain reversible, motivating improved exploration in uniform-reward groups and direct estimation of local recovery effects across evolving repositories, programming languages, and deployment environments. Jointly learning when to reflect, what to diagnose, and how to act turns recovery into an internal policy capability for converting new execution evidence into effective corrections to the current repository state.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在长程编码智能体中识别出「批评到行动交接鸿沟」（Critique-to-Action Handoff Gap），并提出 RIPPLE 以内化仅基于前缀的恢复指导。 阶段特定的信用分配区分了反思触发、诊断与纠正行动，同时保留终端任务监督。 局部有效性门控防止无效的恢复决策继承正向轨迹信用，同时保护有用的纠正不被归因于无关失败的负向信用所波及。 在四个软件工程基准上，RIPPLE 在无需在线评论家的情况下，使基础策略平均提升 4.8 分（算术平均）。 信用分配控制与匹配前缀干预支持了所学批评的功能性贡献。 提升集中在诊断证据充分且仓库状态仍可回退的场景，这促使我们在均匀奖励组中改进探索，并在不断演化的仓库、编程语言与部署环境中直接估计局部恢复效应。 联合学习何时反思、诊断什么以及如何行动，使恢复成为智能体的一种内部策略能力，从而将新的执行证据转化为对当前仓库状态的有效纠正。

paragraphs.en: This section supplies the construction details needed to audit the first contribution: training-time recovery guidance is generated from trajectory prefixes and is internalized into a single deployment policy. paragraphs.en: Snapshot tests run after the rollout and remain hidden from the policy. paragraphs.en: Relative to removal, the full critique adds 23.1 recovery points and reduces P2F by 4.4 points. Direction alone retains 15.6 of the full critique’s 23.1-point benefit; evidence alone retains 4.9. Delay costs 16.9 recovery points and adds 6.1 P2F points. The internal critique is 3.6 recovery points below the teacher reference, with a 0.3-point P2F gap. These contrasts support transferring a timely corrective direction into subsequent actions. Process labels remain approximate and the conclusions are conditional on the fixed prefixes; the main Limitations section discusses test incompleteness, evaluator error, and broader scope.
